topline.text: Another quiet 24-48 hours nationally - no new DfE, Ofsted, safeguarding, SEND or funding announcement cleared the corroboration bar today.
The Talbot Specialist School (Norton Lees, SEND) strike dispute remains unresolved more than a week after NEU members walked out over workload, safety and governance concerns.
topline.action: Worth checking directly with Talbot if you route SEND placements or respite support there this month, in case further strike days disrupt provision.

topline.text: Sheffield City Council decides on Monday whether to fund a 90-place temporary expansion at Hinde House 2-16 School, one of three secondary expansions addressing a city-wide shortage of places.
Reminder: DfE's call for evidence on exclusion reform (behaviour strategies, in-school units, managed moves) closes in 6 days, on 19 November.

diary.text: Sheffield City Council policy committee due to decide £1.1m funding for Hinde House 2-16 School's temporary 90-place expansion.
Anti-Bullying Week 2026 - 'Break the Silence' theme; Odd Socks Day opens the week on 16 Nov.
DfE's call for evidence on school exclusion reform (behaviour strategies, in-school units, managed moves) closes - 6 days away.
DfE due to publish autumn 2025/26 suspensions and permanent exclusions statistics for England.

items.lede: Talbot strike still unresolved, over a week on.
items.body: NEU members at Talbot Specialist School, the Norton Lees SEND school maintained directly by Sheffield City Council, walked out on 5 November over 'excessive workload, safe working practices and a lack of transparency in school governance', with further strike days called into this fortnight. No settlement has been reported; the council says it has asked the union 'to reconsider their proposed action'.
items.action: Worth checking directly with the school if you route SEND placements or respite support there this month.

items.lede: Council to rule on Hinde House expansion funding.
items.body: Sheffield City Council's policy committee meets 16 November to approve £1.1m for a temporary 90-place expansion at Hinde House 2-16 School in Shiregreen - one of three secondary expansions, alongside Forge Valley and Yewlands, planned to meet a forecast shortage of Year 7 places across the city.

box.label: Jargon-buster - in-school units & managed moves
box.intro: Two terms likely to recur as DfE's exclusion reform call for evidence closes on 19 November:
box.text: An in-school unit is an on-site space pupils are moved to for part of the day instead of being suspended; a managed move is an agreed, time-limited transfer to a different mainstream school, used as an alternative to permanent exclusion.
